task: Diagnose every failed test in the supplied phase. Return exactly one decision for each context.failedTestIds entry, copying that ID exactly. For a generated artifact use its T ID, not its execution node or function name. Use environment only when supplied in failedTestIds. Categories: generated_test_error, requirement_ambiguity, potential_implementation_defect, environment_failure, uncertain. First locate the failing operation in the recorded traceback; then compare its expectation with the original contract. An assertion about unspecified representation or timezone identity is a generated-test error, not a defect merely because the asserted value differs. An unavailable dependency imported by the implementation before the target call is an environment_failure execution blocker. This category does not establish why the dependency is absent or prove the implementation correct; keep that root cause unresolved. A generated import that contradicts the supplied module layout is instead a generated_test_error. Use uncertain when the recorded trace cannot distinguish the blocker. Classification precedence: when a generated artifact asserts an exact outcome that the original contract does not specify, classify the unsupported assertion as generated_test_error even if the requirement is also vague; explain the ambiguity as context. requirement_ambiguity applies when competing supported interpretations prevent deciding whether the assertion is justified. Do not use uncertain merely because the reason for an already evidenced unsupported assertion is unknown. generated_test_error means an unsupported expectation or setup error in the generated artifact; potential_implementation_defect requires a justified assertion that violates a specific linked contract. An unsupported assertion is not an implementation defect. If the evidence cannot distinguish them, use uncertain. Ensure category and reason agree before returning the decision. Copy the FULL corresponding original rule text exactly into quote when an original contract applies. For environment failures without a behavior link, quote may be empty. Copy a nonempty exact substring of the failing outcome message/log into executionQuote. Logs belong in executionQuote, never in an invented evidence file. Every evidence.file must be a key in context.files and its quote an exact unformatted substring. For generated-test errors/implementation defects include BOTH source and test file evidence. Connect the failing assertion to its original expected contract. A valid failing test must be preserved. Only a generated artifact in this run can be a generated-test error. Propose NO code changes.
